ideas.pitch: An AI-powered student organization and event discovery platform that pairs incoming freshmen at Michigan State University with campus clubs based on schedule compatibility, skill sets, and peer recommendations.
ideas.title: SpartyMatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem that university organizers and students in the room feel directly on campus every semester, mirroring the localized community impact of winning projects like Outreach.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-based environmental monitoring tool that tracks canopy coverage, urban heat islands, and green space maintenance needs across the Michigan State University campus using multi-spectral imagery.
ideas.title: GreenSpace MSU
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering combined with clear, measurable environmental impact on the local campus landscape, following the pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: Decentralized marketplace and secure escrow platform for MSU student textbook exchanges and subleasing, utilizing instant USDC payments on Base to eliminate scams.
ideas.title: CampusCartel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements autonomous agent logic and crypto escrow payments, directly replicating the exact technical and market architecture of Dispatch.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven dining hall nutrition assistant that scans MSU campus dining menus in real-time, delivering personalized macro breakdowns and allergy alerts for students on restricted diets.
ideas.title: NutriSparty
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an immediate daily pain point for students eating at campus cafeterias, perfectly aligning with the consumer-health utility seen in E-Foodiee.

ideas.pitch: An incident-forecasting dashboard that predicts power outages and grid failure probabilities across midwestern municipal sectors using Poisson regression and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: MidwestGrid Predict
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling and predictive analytics to a critical infrastructure domain, mirroring the winning approach of ai-incident-forecasting.
